notes.title: We’ve been hard at work rebuilding Last Contingency
notes.content:
We’ve been hard at work rebuilding Last Contingency from the ground up to improve the game and set the foundation for future updates. While this is a major step forward, we know there’s still work to do, and we need your help to make the game even better!

What’s New?
Complete Game Rebuild – We’ve reworked core systems to improve performance, stability, and future expandability.
Improved Mechanics – While some features are still in progress, we’re refining animations, interactions, and core survival elements.
Crafting & Items – We’re in the process of adding new items and refining the crafting system to enhance gameplay depth.
Bug Fixes & Optimizations – We've fixed various issues but are still working through others, so we appreciate your patience and reports!
What’s Next?
More Animations & Polish – Expect improvements in character movement, combat, and interactions.
Expanded Crafting & Items – We're adding more tools, weapons, and survival elements.
Bug Fixing & Community Feedback – Your reports and suggestions are essential to making this game the best it can be!
We Need Your Help!
This rebuild is a fresh start, and we’re counting on the community’s feedback to track bugs, suggest features, and help shape the game. Please report issues and share ideas via our Discord or Steam discussions.

Enjoy the update, and we look forward to hearing from you!

- The Last Contingency Team

notes.title: Huge update
notes.content:
A short list of what awaits you in the new update:

* Footstep system was updated
* Building system was updated 
* Fishing System (fishing rod, worms, new logic)
* Advanced starting customisation / 
* Advanced AI Improvements (a huge amount of work, more details after the release)
* AI Companions (system of orders, joining in a group, reworked archers and shooters, new behavior trees and so on)
* New characters with unique behaviours (hen, rooster, chick, pig, swine, piglet) & advanced new logic
* Farming system (quite a complex system, in which we put our heart and soul). You will be able to grow animals
* New building objects: fences, high walls, gates, spiked walls, coops, feeders and so on. Most of the new buildings have animations and new extra logic. Water Storage, with placeholder logic for now. 



* We also fixed various bugs that you found and reported!

The update will be available sometime in mid-summer (September). Maybe sooner, maybe.

* [b]With this big update there will be a little price increase .[/b]

Thank you for your time and patience!

LC Development

notes.title: Future Update
notes.content:
A new update will be launched at the beginning of next month. Our Devs are working hard on fixing known issues and adding additional content.
Reworking farming systems and adding additional resources.
Adding animals and the ability to breed and feed livestock.
Reworking electrical components and power systems.
Additional tools will also be added to the crafting menu.

Our discord link has been updated and added to the store page. 

Thanks for you patience and looking forward to hearing your reviews.
